mapper.select: select username as username, password as password, use_permissions as permissions, created_date as created_date, updated_date as updated_date from interviewworks.permissionsdata where username = #{username} order by permissionsdata.updated_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into interviewworks.permissionsdata (username, password, use_permissions) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{permissions})
mapper.select: select concat( username, ' - ', use_permissions) from interviewworks.permissionsdata order by permissionsdata.updated_date desc
